svg.title: Four posts filed by word, and the query "world cup" intersecting two posting lists
svg.desc: Posts 9004 world cup final tonight, 9003 tea at the world cafe, 9002 cup of tea, 9001 world cup squad named. Posting lists newest first: world 9004 9003 9001, cup 9004 9002 9001, tea 9003 9002. Walking world and cup with one pointer each gives matches 9004 and 9001.
svg.text: each term lists the posts that contain it, newest first
query "world cup": one pointer per list, intersect
always move the pointer on the
larger id: each entry read once
